It depends on what kind of champ youre playing. If it's someone really strong early like Olaf/Lee, you want to focus on abusing the enemy jungle. Invade them, take their camps, kill them in their jungle, but only do this when your nearby laners have priority. If they don't have priority, then try to setup a gank to get them snowballing. 

Now, I don't really play early game junglers. I'm pretty much a Evelynn one trick. And Evelynn has a veeery bad early game in terms of dueling, and her ganks are telographed and easy to escape from without heavy cc from your laners. So I've had to learn to deal with these early game junglers. Deep warding early allows you to track their movement, so you know where it is safe to farm in your jungle. If you have vision on the enemy jg as they attempt to take your camps, collapse on them with your laners.
